title: Profile: Together, Fireworks, DeepInfra and DeepSeek hosts
goal: Where each OpenAI-compatible host follows or deviates from the protocol, model naming and limits. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
